# Project Skills

This folder contains project-specific agent skills for safer and more consistent delivery.

## Available skills
- firebase-safe-deploy
- firestore-rules-change
- frontend-rtl-qa
- cloud-functions-change

## Usage
- In Copilot Chat, type / and select the skill name.
- Optionally provide a short argument describing changed area and expected behavior.

## Goal
- Reduce deployment mistakes.
- Improve security review quality.
- Keep Arabic RTL UI updates stable.
- Enforce functions build/test discipline.
